finding: A JSON-RPC initialize POSTed to https://huggingface.co/mcp with no credentials answered HTTP 200 on 2026-10-03 at 06:04:04Z: serverInfo huggingface.co/mcp 0.4.27, a minted mcp-session-id, and an instructions field that says in the vendor's own words "The Hugging Face tools are being used anonymously and rate limits apply", pointing the user to a token or an account for higher limits. The vendor's setup page assumes a logged-in user and never mentions anonymous use; the server's own handshake does, and the source README names the behaviour ("token-less requests continue with the anonymous tool set"). So the keyless path exists, is deliberate, and is disclosed by the surface itself rather than by the documentation. No rate limit was measured on this path and no RateLimit header was served on it; the Hub REST API answered the same container with the anonymous bucket's policy header, 500 per 5 minutes.
